The tallest is Georgios Tanoulis at 210 cm. The youngest is Georgios Tanoulis (born 2002) and the most experienced Stefan Jovic (born 1990). Beyond Greece, the squad draws most on USA (3), Canada (1) and France (1). Eleftherios Bochoridis, Elijah Mitrou-Long, Stylianos Poulianitis and Vassilis Toliopoulos are back for another spell at the club.
